descriptions.rgb: From a steep downward egocentric viewpoint, the camera wearer looks down at a cushioned beige and grey armrest situated about 0.4 to 0.5 metres below the camera, with a wooden floor, a small tray on the lower left, and a stool base on the lower right located roughly 0.7 to 0.9 metres below. Seated directly in front of and facing toward the camera wearer at a distance of roughly 0.5 to 0.8 metres is another person whose head and torso are out of view above the top edge, leaving only their black-clad legs at the upper right and both forearms extending forward into the scene. Resting on the left side of the armrest is a white UV/LED nail lamp, within about 0.1 to 0.2 metres of the adjacent grey towel pad on the right; the seated person's right hand is placed inside and largely occluded by this lamp, while their left hand extends forward over the lamp and pad toward the bottom center. At the bottom edge, about 0.3 to 0.4 metres from the camera, the camera wearer's two hands are in direct contact with the seated person's left thumb, with the camera wearer's left hand holding a partially occluded dark bottle and the thumb, and their right hand holding a blue-tipped brush; the lamp, cushion, and hands are all well within arm's reach of both people. Across the five frames from left to right, the camera viewpoint shifts slightly downward and rightward while the seated person's left hand moves a few centimetres to the right off the lamp casing in the first three frames and tilts slightly in the fifth frame as the brush retreats a couple of centimetres to the lower right.
